CC: thick painful nails

HPI: 6 months of symptoms relating to thickened painful nails. Sensory neuropathy noted on prior visits. Peripheral vascular disease noted.

Exam: nails examined consistent with thickened painful nails; no other findings recorded.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.

Procedure: Debridement of 1 to 5 thickened nails performed with sterile technique. Tolerated well, no immediate complications.

(End of note.)
